jobs.title: Pre-Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. At least 3 years of experience in a pre-sales engineer, solutions consultant, or similar role within SaaS companies, with a clear focus on supporting the sales function Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, including pain-point discovery, objection handling, and value proposition articulation Knowledge of SaaS architecture, API integrations, billing, and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)
